# ”Någon borde ta bolaget i örat”

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-28  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon for Friday 28 August 2026 focused on Fed chair Kevin Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech, a 4.68% US 10-year yield, oil at $86 amid Hormuz and OPEC news, and a strong US tech rally led by Nvidia and Salesforce that also lifted Swedish software stocks. On the company side, Intrum's Q2 was weak (cut servicing outlook, more cost cuts, still highly leveraged), Sivers Semiconductors' report was harshly criticised, Tobii kept struggling, Boozt's major owner sold its whole stake, and Boliden's big acquisition drew broad market scepticism.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers Semiconductors | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Report called catastrophic: sales -12%, heavy cash burn, pipeline hype. Host says the company isn't serious. Still ~8bn SEK market cap after a ~700% YTD run.

#### Reasoning

Host opinion. Sales are falling and losses are large, but management sells a non-binding 'opportunity pipeline' to keep confidence up. The host calls it 'konstinstallation med ekonomisk mumbo jumbo' and says people laugh at the numbers. The stock has fallen from 100 to 36 but is still up ~700% YTD at ~8bn SEK, so the valuation rests on hopes rather than results.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pipeline converts into binding orders and revenue growth
- if cash burn stops and losses shrink materially

> *"Jag tycker att nån borde ta det här bolaget i örat och säga att så här kan man inte hålla på."*

---

### 🟠 INTRUM — Intrum | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Weak Q2: servicing outlook cut, cost cuts accelerated, leverage 6.2x. The new capital isn't on the balance sheet yet; the new management is trusted.

#### Reasoning

Host view is mixed. Operations are weak: lower result, servicing outlook cut, more savings, and leverage rose from 5.7x to 6.2x. The 7.5bn SEK capital injection is not yet in the balance sheet, and hosts like the humble new management. They say not to read too much into this one report, but see 'grus i maskineriet' and question whether Intrum can afford the higher investment volumes it wants.

#### Sell Triggers

- if leverage stays high after the capital injection is booked
- if further servicing guidance cuts
- if collection investments cannot be funded

> *"Men ändå tråkigt att man inte ser så positiva tecken att det rullar på som det ska. Det är grus i maskineriet."*

---

### ⛔ TOBII — Tobii | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sharp sales decline, markets described as volatile, stock down ~90%; hosts say it 'ser fortsatt ganska jobbigt ut'.

#### Reasoning

Host commentary on the report released during the show: sales fell sharply (partly one-off items), the CEO calls markets volatile, and the stock has lost ~90% of its value. Hosts note owners would have done better in Dynavox. They show no sign of a turnaround.

#### Sell Triggers

- if revenue stabilises and returns to growth
- if market conditions normalise

> *"Kraftig omsättningsnedgång. Jämförelsestörande poster i och för sig. Men det ser fortsatt ganska jobbigt ut."*

---

### 🟡 BOL — Boliden | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Handelsbanken cut it from buy to hold after the large Latin American deal. One host is optimistic long term; another cites past trouble with foreign mines.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst view: Handelsbanken cut to hold, and almost all market voices were negative on the transformative deal. Host opinion is split. One host thinks it will be 'jättebra' long term and praises Swedish risk-taking. Another notes Boliden's history of problems running mines in Canada and elsewhere abroad. Overall this points to hold rather than buying before the deal's integration is clearer.

#### Sell Triggers

- if integration problems at the Latin American mines appear
- if acquisition financing strains the balance sheet

> *"Jag tror att det här på sikt kommer bli jättebra."*

---
